# Ostar Rawful Lair collection editions

Version 0.1 · Common format for the Rasniki collection

The collection is presented through three reading editions: Makkakah, Aantonymmakkakah, and Jurisdiction Review. Ostar, ainsuitable, and rawful retain their provisional meanings. “Ainsuitable” means conformity to the documented edition format here, not external certification. This publication is AI-assisted.

## Makkakah edition

Read each system as a practice to sustain: identify its purpose, steward, resources, maintenance, acceptance checks, and next review. Preserve useful work while observing its actual effects.

## Aantonymmakkakah edition

Read each system as a practice open to reframing: identify assumptions, competing interpretations, proposed repair, affected people, and what should be revised or retired. Aantonymmakkakah retains its own meaning and is not reduced to an antonym label.

## Jurisdiction-review edition

Read each system with attention to its applicable rules, permissions, claims, and unresolved review. All material remains unreviewed unless an actual relevant review is documented. This edition has no verified legal-rule database and cannot guarantee validity in every jurisdiction. Entering a location, reading a document, or selecting this edition does not create legal authority.

## Whole-collection format

Every browser page has a common edition selector and navigation back to the collection. Edition choice is carried in the URL to other local HTML pages. It changes framing and presentation, not the underlying algorithms, permissions, governance results, or implementation status. The jurisdiction selector does not approve anything.

The Ostar home groups the collection into lore and dwelling, making and writing, software and exchange, stewardship and negotiation, and context and review. The detailed tools and their source documents remain available. Existing professional, clinical, safety, legal, and architecture limitations continue to apply.

The primary publication now uses three encoded .io scripts and publication.html. They include documents, software, interfaces, tests, and the unchanged license as integrity-checked records. Earlier compiled Markdown editions remain editorial/archive artifacts; browser document links now open the encoded reader. Source text is preserved rather than executed.

## Refreshing the editions

Run `python3 software/build_editions.py` from the repository root after changing source documents. Generated files are in editions/. The builder uses the existing checkout and never creates a worktree. It rewrites only its named generated edition files, not canonical sources or the license.

Then run `python3 software/build_io_publication.py` to refresh the primary encoded scripts and offline reader data. See IO_PUBLICATION.md for the declarative instructions, limits, and integrity-check contract.

The browser reformat does not implement proposed specialist software, a native operating system, external platform integrations, authenticated elections, or automatic legal compliance. Its purpose is a coherent, navigable format for the current collection.
